critical_code_review_comments: sanitize.js configuration is tight and correct — ALLOWED_TAGS covers editorial vocabulary; addHook forces rel=noopener noreferrer on any target=_blank. Note the hook is registered at module import time (side-effect on the global DOMPurify instance) — acceptable for a single-page CRA app, but worth being aware of in unit-test contexts.

ALLOWED_TAGS currently omits <table>/<thead>/<tbody>/<tr>/<td>/<th>. If editors ever paste tabular data (e.g. price comparison tables), they will be stripped silently. Consider expanding if that's a real use case.
Body content is stored raw in Mongo (as documented). Any future non-browser renderer (RSS/email) must apply its own sanitiser — good that this is called out in comments.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 blogs via /api/admin/blogs during XSS payload tests, ALL deleted at end of run. Also created 2 Aramya leads (regression) that persist in Mongo (TEST_ prefix on first_name).
